Senior Motion Graphics Designer – Product Videos & UI Animation 
 Company: CredX
 Location: Hyderabad (On-site)
 Experience: 3–6 years
 CTC: ₹6–10 LPA
 About the Role 
 CredX is looking for a Senior Motion Graphics Designer to lead product video creation, UI animation, and brand storytelling for our verification-first hiring platform.
 This is a founding creative role with significant ownership and direct collaboration with the founder.
 Key Responsibilities 

• Create high-quality SaaS product launch videos and feature announcement films.

• Animate product interfaces and app features using Figma designs.

• Develop kinetic typography, smooth transitions, motion posters, and animated brand assets.

• Produce explainers, recruitment videos, and promotional content for LinkedIn, Instagram, and YouTube.

• Handle storyboarding, animation, sound design, editing, and final delivery.

 Required Skills 

• 3–6 years of professional motion design experience.

• Advanced Adobe After Effects skills, including keyframe animation, timing, and easing.

• Experience creating UI animations from Figma or static designs.

• Strong visual storytelling, storyboarding, and kinetic typography.

• Proficiency in Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve, Illustrator, and Photoshop.

 Mandatory Portfolio Requirement 
 Applicants must share a showreel containing at least one SaaS product launch video, app explainer, or UI animation project. Static graphic design portfolios alone will not qualify.
 Preferred: Blender, Cinema 4D, Lottie, Rive, sound design, and AI-assisted video production.
 How to Apply 
 Please submit your updated resume and portfolio/showreel link demonstrating your motion design capabilities.
